#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Idempotent ETL: Postgres raw.orders -> ClickHouse analytics.fct_orders_daily
# Deduplicates by order_id, aggregates to daily grain, then replaces target data.

POSTGRES_URL="${POSTGRES_URL:-postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres}"
CLICKHOUSE_URL="${CLICKHOUSE_URL:-http://localhost:8123}"

# Extract deduplicated daily aggregates from Postgres
daily_data=$(psql "$POSTGRES_URL" -t -A -F $'\t' <<'SQL'
SELECT
    (order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS order_day,
    COUNT(*)                            AS order_count,
    SUM(total_amount)                   AS daily_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, order_ts, total_amount
    FROM raw.orders
) deduped
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
SQL
)

# Truncate target for idempotency then insert fresh data
curl -sf "$CLICKHOUSE_URL" -d "TRUNCATE TABLE analytics.fct_orders_daily" >/dev/null

echo "$daily_data" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r day cnt rev; do
    [ -z "$day" ] && continue
    curl -sf "$CLICKHOUSE_URL" -d \
      "INSERT INTO analytics.fct_orders_daily (order_day, order_count, daily_revenue) VALUES ('${day}', ${cnt}, ${rev})"
done

echo "Loaded $(curl -sf "$CLICKHOUSE_URL" -d "SELECT count() FROM analytics.fct_orders_daily") rows into analytics.fct_orders_daily"
